findings.detail: P4-001 requires date filters and the request schema supports freshness modes any, after, before, and between. Both deterministic fixture providers advertise supports_freshness=true and accept bounded freshness requests, but DeterministicFixtureSearchProvider._matches() filters only language, country, domains, and query text. It never evaluates request.freshness against entry.published_at. The fixture corpus exercises only mode=any, and regressions cover unsupported freshness capability but not supported freshness semantics. Consequently, a provider can claim freshness support while returning out-of-range or undated results, so the stated P4-001 source-contract completion criterion is not met.
requiredChanges: Define deterministic boundary semantics for after, before, and between.
Apply bounded freshness filtering to published_at; explicitly define behavior for null published_at.
Add fixture cases and regressions for all modes, equality boundaries, null dates, and both fixture providers.
Register or map canonical Test Center coverage for supported freshness-filter behavior.
Regenerate affected registry/hierarchy/evidence/generated state and SOURCE_MANIFEST.sha256 through canonical owners.
Rerun the full exact-head matrix and request a fresh Worker J review.
